events.name: Global Ransomware Strike
events.description: A ransomware cartel (state-adjacent) hits clearing networks in 3 countries simultaneously.
events.advisorText: Our models suggest this was pre-positioned. Expect follow-on strikes within 2 turns.

events.name: Climate Migration Surge
events.description: A heat event triggers mass displacement across the Sahel. EU and Gulf Bloc face border pressure.
events.advisorText: Demographic pressure will compound for 3+ turns unless addressed domestically.

events.name: Fabricated Diplomatic Cable Leak
events.description: An LLM-generated cable purportedly from the US State Department surfaces, implying willingness to abandon Taiwan.
events.advisorText: Intel confidence on this cable is low. Our analysts rate it 35% authentic.

events.name: Big Tech Data Breach
events.description: A major US cloud provider suffers a state-level intrusion. Classified contractor data exposed.
events.advisorText: Attribution is unclear. Could be CN, RU, or a cartel with state backing.

events.name: Himalayan Border Skirmish
events.description: A patrol clash at LAC leaves 4 soldiers dead. Both sides mobilize forward brigades.
events.advisorText: India will likely hedge further from US alignment in the short term.

events.name: Strait of Hormuz Incident
events.description: An unattributed mine strike disables a tanker. Insurance rates spike. Oil hits $140.
events.advisorText: The Gulf Bloc will prioritize economic over strategic positioning this turn.

events.name: ASAT Debris Event
events.description: An orbital debris field from an undisclosed ASAT test threatens commercial and military satellites.
events.advisorText: C4ISR degradation will affect all powers' real-time battlefield awareness for 2 turns.

events.name: EU Internal Split
events.description: Hungary and Slovakia block an EU sanctions package. The bloc's unified response mechanism stalls.
events.advisorText: EU action points may be reduced next turn.

events.name: Biosafety Level-4 Incident
events.description: A containment breach at a dual-use research facility triggers international alarm. Origin disputed.
events.advisorText: Domestic stability impacts will be severe if not managed within 3 turns.

financial_fragmentation.description: Global clearing networks begin to fragment. Cross-border payments disrupted.

internet_balkanization.description: Major powers begin enforcing sovereign internet controls. Information flows restricted.

domestic_fragility_cascade.description: Mass displacement events compound. Climate migration accelerates destabilization.

communications_blackout.description: Satellite communications unreliable. Military C4ISR severely degraded for all powers.
